new_integration_finding: Separate archive admission race: append_observations loads the last 100000 IDs, computes unseen IDs, then appends without a shared lock or transaction. Two concurrent writers can both admit the same observation_id. Coherent final JSON timestamps and reader-visible snapshot tests alone do not establish append-only archive idempotence. This is a source-derived risk, not an observed duplicate.
no_network_test_contract: Use a known valid FlowObservation fixture and shared tmp_path/observations.jsonl. Start two concurrent append_observations calls with the same observation. For baseline only, gate both after reading existing IDs using a bounded synchronization timeout, allowing a serialized fix to wait without deadlock. Join both in finally with timeout; require no exceptions, exactly one archived observation_id and sum(returned appended counts)==1. Baseline RED only if both witnessed the empty-ID read and duplicate lines were observed. Run the test plus full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests at exact SHA; separately preserve two-writer JSON and reader-visibility gates.
